summary: Valion Bio filed a routine Item 8.01/9.01 8-K furnishing a press release dated October 14, 2026, describing its wholly owned subsidiary Velocity Bioworks and its San Antonio facility's process development, analytical services, and early-phase clinical drug substance manufacturing amid a domestic CDMO surge tied to Section 232 tariffs. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed; the filing merely publicizes operational capabilities. Signed by Interim CEO Dean Zikria. No structural or regulatory mechanics arise. What to watch: no deal terms; arbitrage angles absent.
